bulkDeployment.title: Bulk Deployment Management
bulkDeployment.description: Batch import and initialize new devices, panels, ports and cable connections

sections.devicesDescription: Support batch import of device information through Excel/CSV files, including:
devicesFeatures: Device type (SERVER, SWITCH, ROUTER, FIREWALL, STORAGE, PDU, OTHER)
Associated cabinet and U position allocation
Automatic validation of data integrity and legality
sections.panelsDescription: Quickly create standard device panel configurations from predefined templates:
panelsFeatures: Network device standard panel templates (24 ports, 48 ports, etc.)
Server panel templates (dual network ports, management ports, etc.)
sections.cablesDescription: Batch import cable connection information through Excel/CSV files:
cablesFeatures: Port IDs of ends A and B, optional plug labels (empty: allocated)
Each row is submitted on its own; failed rows are listed

alerts.assistantDescription: Support batch import of device and cable information through Excel/CSV files, quickly complete the device rack-mounting work of data centers.
alerts.tipsDescription: Create data centers, rooms and cabinets first. In the device sheet a cabinet can be given by name or ID.

validation.cabinetIdRequired: Cabinet not found (use its name or ID)
validation.uPositionInvalid: U position must be a number between 1 and 60
validation.uHeightInvalid: U height must be a positive integer
validation.cableLengthInvalid: Length must be a positive number
